test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which was the only nationalised bank in India before 1969?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SBI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **State Bank of India (SBI)** was the only nationalized commercial bank in India before the major nationalization drive of **1969**. It was nationalized on **1 July 1955**.
 
• The nationalization was carried out under the **State Bank of India Act, 1955**, which followed the recommendations of the **All India Rural Credit Survey Committee (1954)**.
 
• Prior to its nationalization, it was known as the **Imperial Bank of India**, which had been created in **1921** by amalgamating the three presidency banks: the **Bank of Bengal (1806)**, the **Bank of Bombay (1840)**, and the **Bank of Madras (1843)**.
 
• While the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** was nationalized earlier in **1949**, it serves as the **central bank** and regulator of the country, whereas **SBI** functioned as the sole nationalized **commercial bank** during the **1955-1969** period.
 
• This move was intended to extend banking facilities to rural and semi-urban areas and to provide credit for agricultural and industrial development, fulfilling the government's social and economic objectives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nationalization of 14 Banks (1969):**

 
 
• On **19 July 1969**, the Government of India, led by Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi**, nationalized **14 major commercial banks**.
 
• These banks were selected because they held deposits exceeding **50 crore**.
 
• The list included **Central Bank of India**, **Bank of Baroda**, **Allahabad Bank**, Punjab National Bank, Canara Bank, and others.
 
 
 
• **Nationalization of 6 Banks (1980):**
 
 
• A second phase of nationalization occurred on **15 April 1980**, involving **6 more banks**.
 
• These banks were nationalized as their demand and time liabilities exceeded **200 crore**.
 
 
 
• **State Bank of India (SBI) Today:**
 
 
• It is currently the **largest public sector bank** in India and a **Fortune 500** company.
 
• Headquartered in **Mumbai**, it has over **22,000 branches** and a significant international presence.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Associate Banks of SBI:** In **1959**, the **State Bank of India (Subsidiary Banks) Act** was passed, which enabled SBI to take over eight state-associated banks as its subsidiaries (later known as Associate Banks).
 
• **SBI Merger (2017):** In a landmark move on **1 April 2017**, five associate banks (State Bank of Bikaner and Jaipur, State Bank of Hyderabad, State Bank of Mysore, State Bank of Patiala, and State Bank of Travancore) and the **Bharatiya Mahila Bank** were merged into the **State Bank of India**.
 
• **Banking Regulation:** All nationalized banks, including SBI, are regulated under the **Banking Regulation Act, 1949**, alongside the specific acts under which they were established.
 
• **Allahabad Bank:** It was the oldest joint-stock bank in India, established in **1865**, but it was a **private entity** until its nationalization in **1969**. It was recently merged into the **Indian Bank** in **2020**.
